title: ComposerAttachment
description: composer.attachment@1: one file a person attached to a message in the shared composer. Media stores it and answers this shape from POST /api/v1/attachments (multipart field `file`); a client keeps it until the message is sent, then names it in POST /api/v1/attachments/:id/keep. `kind` is sniffed from the bytes, never taken from the browser: image, video, audio, file or code. `thumb` is a small preview for images and video (absent for the rest), `w`/`h` the pixel size when the file is one Media can measure. An attachment nobody keeps expires after 24 hours; `expires_at` says when, and a keep extends it to the message's life.

id.description: The attachment id (att_ + ULID): what DELETE /api/v1/attachments/:id and POST /api/v1/attachments/:id/keep name.

kind.description: Decided by Media from the bytes, not the client's claim: image/video/audio when the signature matches, code for recognised source text, otherwise file. Executables are refused at upload.

name.description: The file's original name, sanitised for display; never a path.

mime.description: The content type Media serves the bytes as, from the sniffed kind and format.

url.description: Absolute https URL the bytes are served at. It stays valid while the attachment exists; a kept attachment is the message's to serve.

thumb.description: Absolute URL of a preview image: an image's own small copy or a video's first frame. Null when Media could not make one (or the kind has none).

w.description: Pixel width of an image, video or video preview; null when unknown.

h.description: Pixel height of an image, video or video preview; null when unknown.

expires_at.description: When an unkept attachment is deleted. The upload answers now + 24 hours; a keep moves it to the kept window.
